APO 500
14 June 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminal.
The following Japanese is named as a Suspected War Criminal, and is being delivered to the Commanding General, EIGHTH Army for internment at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp).
NAME | RANK | PERTINENT DATA
NOGUCHI, Terumitsu | Sgt/Maj | Sailed from Rabaul 5 Mar 46 on board vessel Harizuki, Embarkation No. 88.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
